newsitem.title: USA: Streicher Mobile Fueling names new CFO.
newsitem.headline: Streicher Mobile Fueling names new CFO.

text.p: Streicher Mobile Fueling Inc said on Tuesday that Walter Barrett had joined the company as its new chief financial officer, succeeding William Tetsworth.
Streicher did not disclose a reason for Tetworth's leaving the post.
Barrett, 39, joined Streicher from Devcon International Corp, a heavy construction and construction materials firm where he had served as a vice president and chief financial officer since 1991.
Streicher Mobile Fueling Inc provides mobile fueling services.
